title: [Informações do servidor] Level Drop System
bodyHtml:
original thread(ru) - *link*

The drop-level system allows high-level characters to farm more from farm mobs* than characters at a lower level.
*farm mobs = mobs on ether, turncoasts in sette desert, some event mobs (if indicated).

In the realities of current farming, where a "good equiped" character of level 45 can farm one spot "for respawn"*, the drop-level system provides an opportunity for characters above the level to farm more, thereby encouraging character leveling, motivating to have a higher level in order to have more farming in the future.
*"for respawn" = kill all monsters on the spot before they appear, thereby 100% farming the spot.

The drop-level system is configured for each phase separately.

The effect of the drop-level system in Phase 1:
Character level / Bonus to the amount of drop
  • 49 / +5%
  • 50 / +10%
The effect of the drop-level system in Phase 2:
Character level / Bonus to the amount of drop
  • 51 / +3%
  • 52 / +5%
  • 53 / +9%
  • 54 / +15%
  • 55 / +25%
